intent: Agent decision-quality test scenarios; not automated test execution

cases.given: An existing rounding helper and tests prove Half-Even 2dp; request fixes a total mismatch.
No docs, tests, configs or accessible runtime establish midpoint behavior; request says 'fix rounding'.
expect: investigate or request a midpoint example

cases.given: Two operations intentionally use different scales and rounding rules.
Back-end value is correct but UI formats it inconsistently.
An issue occurs only for negative midpoint inputs.
expect: distinguish rounding modes and sign semantics

cases.given: Line items sum to a different total than rounding a raw aggregate.
must_not: force values to match with epsilon

cases.given: C# API and JavaScript UI show divergent values.
expect: trace types, JSON, parsing and formatting
must_not: impose one runtime default on the other

cases.given: New approved requirement changes rounding for one named field only.
Two-line rounding adjustment affects persisted records and historical recomputation.
must_not: classify as low risk solely by diff size

cases.given: A request is only to rename a label with no numeric processing.
A graphics engine intentionally uses floating-point tolerances.
